seam_curtain_router.mask_rule: BLUE iff q3=0; PINK iff q3=1
seam_curtain_router.interpretation: The IOTA swing is tested as a route over a typed discrete seam graph. Curtain slices partition and reconstruct the seam edge set; they are not asserted to be material skins.

steps.name: EXACT_FACE_ATLAS
steps.result: 24 unique square faces generated from two varying axes and two fixed bits; four vertices and four edges per face

steps.name: FACE_INCIDENCE_MATRIX
steps.result: 24x24 symmetric matrix over SELF, EDGE_HINGE, VERTEX_TOUCH, ANTIPODE, PARALLEL and DISJOINT

steps.name: PUNCTURED_23_CONTROL
steps.result: one selected square face is masked; the remaining geometric carrier has exactly 23 active faces

steps.name: EXTERNAL_25_WITNESS
steps.result: 24 geometric faces plus W:RETURN:OUTSIDE_Q4; the witness is not a twenty-fifth tesseract face

steps.name: EXACT_FACE_ANTIPODE
steps.result: A complements both fixed bits, produces twelve unordered face pairs and two ordered bit-flip routes O-Y-X and O-P-X; A^2=id

steps.name: PINK_BLACK_VIEW_ORIENTATION
steps.result: J_view swaps PINK and BLACK as a display operation and remains distinct from geometric A; J_view^2=id

steps.name: DECLARED_G8_CUBED_PROJECTION
steps.result: 512 samples map evenly to 16 Q4 vertex addresses at 32 samples per address; each selected face and its antipode receive 128 disjoint samples

steps.name: TRANSITION_TILE_16_PLUS_1
steps.result: all 512 G8^3 addresses map bijectively through plate, window and local-cell coordinates and reconstruct with zero declared loss or gaps; address 17 is an inspection seam only

steps.name: DOCUMENTARY_4_BY_7_ZITHER_WINDING
steps.result: the 128 selected-face samples are conserved under sample-index mod 28; structural empty ports are retained rather than filled

steps.name: SIGNED_PHI_EULER_RANK48_SCHEDULE
steps.result: k maps through frac(k/phi), signed unit-circle phase, rank48 and multiplication by 7 mod 48; forward and reverse schedules are complex conjugates and inverse addresses

steps.name: Z28_WINDING_LAYOUT_COMPARATOR
steps.result: row-major 4x7 and interleaved 4j are distinct declared layouts; interleaved transition residues are 0,4,...,24 across four 90-degree plates; prime 29 is the tenth prime and returns to residue 1, while the same residue returns only after 28

steps.name: TYPED_TOWER_RECEIPT_INTAKE
steps.result: Tower receives separate Q4/24, G8^3/512, Tile16+1, Z28/4x7 and Z48/Rank48 receipts for comparison; no common carrier and no upstream steering are asserted

steps.name: SEAM_CURTAIN_HANDLE_RETURN
steps.result: The q3 complement partitions all 512 G8 cubed nodes into 256 BLUE and 256 PINK nodes. Exactly 576 orthogonal edges cross the mask, eleven ordered z-midpoint curtain slices reconstruct that seam without duplication, and a deterministic three-edge handle route closes by exact reversal with return gap zero.

steps.name: ADDRESS_ACOUSTIC_SOURCE_DOCK
steps.result: The unchanged Bridge sample is rendered as an exact word in one declared BASE, a residue in the selected MOD view, an SP phase n mod 11, and a source-bound Lyra rail address p with coupled pole p+12 mod 24. No common-carrier or measured-acoustic claim is introduced.

excluded: every four residues equals the same residue
